summary: Android app that carries TAK Cursor-on-Target traffic (PLI, GeoChat, point markers, emergency alerts) over analog VHF/UHF radios using a software Bell 202 AFSK modem with optional FX.25 error correction, an external KISS TNC, a P25 radio's packet data service (any make), a MOTOTRBO or Hytera (DMR) radio's data service on USB, or the transparent serial data port of an Icom D-STAR or Kenwood/Icom NXDN radio (USB or Bluetooth serial). Acts as a local TCP TAK server for ATAK; no ATAK plugin.

architecture.pattern: Pure-Kotlin core library + thin Android shell. Manual constructor wiring (AppContainer), no DI framework. UI is single-activity Jetpack Compose reading StateFlows. The gateway runs in a foreground service on plain threads.
rules: :core has no Android imports; all protocol/modem/crypto/scheduling logic and all unit tests live there
:usbserial is vendored third-party source; do not edit
Over-air format changes must follow docs/PROTOCOL.md versioning rules
RF traffic is never retransmitted except by store-and-forward relaying of chat, markers and emergency alerts (opt-in, single hop, rate-limited; docs/PROTOCOL.md section 9)
PTT must be released in finally blocks, on service destroy, on USB detach and by the TX watchdog; when the Bluetooth PTT link drops, transmitting is disabled and audio aborted

ax25.responsibility: AX.25 addresses and UI frames, CRC-16-CCITT FCS, HDLC flags/bit stuffing, NRZI, FX.25 framing (correlation tags, encoder, bit-level receiver) and the Reed-Solomon codec (GF(2^8) 0x11D, fcr 1; Dire Wolf compatible)

modem.responsibility: Bell 202 AFSK 1200 baud at 48 kHz: modulator (plain or FX.25), multi-slicer demodulator with PLL, an HDLC deframer and an FX.25 receiver per slicer, CRC de-duplication, fecRecovered counter, DCD, level meter, FIR design

codec.responsibility: Over-air binary payload (PLI/Chat/Marker/Emergency), field encodings and caps, the extension byte (hop count, age, PLI report counter), payload encryption suites and key loading
codec.notes: PayloadCrypto.kt holds PayloadCipher, AeadCipher (suites 0/1), EciesCipher (suites 2/3), KeyLoader (passphrase, key files, PEM, ECDH, HKDF). PacketCodec.encode(hiddenSource=) writes a version-1 hidden-source packet (station address sealed after the type byte; refuses without a cipher); decode returns it as DecodeResult.Ok.hiddenSource. Encrypting codecs always reserve Wire.HIDDEN_SOURCE_MAX_SIZE in chats.

cot.responsibility: CoT XML: hardened parsing (including the <emergency> detail), stream splitting on </event>, classification of client events (b-a-* alerts become EmergencyMessage), rebuilding XML for RF traffic

sched.responsibility: Injected clock, PLI scheduler, priority TX queue (alerts > chat > markers > PLI), loop guard, p-persistent CSMA, time-slot schedule and channel access, geo helpers, store and forward (RepeatConfig limits, RepeatStore, SeenCache, and their binary save/restore via HeldMessageIo), EmergencyBeacon (repeats own active alerts every 30 s, cancel 3 times)

stats.responsibility: Rolling 10-minute channel statistics in 10 s buckets: channel busy, own air time, RX/TX event counts (ChannelEvent), snapshot as ChannelHealth

radio.responsibility: BluetoothRadios: recognises supported radios/TNCs by Bluetooth name (BluetoothRadioMatch model + BluetoothRadioUse KISS_CLASSIC | KISS_BLE | DSTAR_DATA; advice only). RadioGuide: advice-only band plan data and rules for the radio guide. RadioService (AMATEUR/BUSINESS), Band (VHF/UHF), ChannelWidth (NARROW/WIDE with peak and data deviation), Terrain; recommendedBand and reasons per terrain, FX.25 suggestion, terrain tips, radio checklist for data, suggested and to-avoid frequencies (ARRL 2 m packet channels, 70 cm 445-447 local option, Part 90 itinerant channels from 47 CFR 90.35). US rules only. Business band is always NARROW (effectiveWidth)

profile.responsibility: TeamProfile: the team-wide settings as a takwave://profile?... link (also file and QR content); strict validation, slot assignment table, never key material

gateway.responsibility: I/O-free heart of the app: client CoT -> queue -> AX.25 frames, and RF frames -> CoT; optional hideSource (AX.25 source Gateway.HIDDEN_SOURCE = TAKWV-15, real address inside the ciphertext; receive uses the inner address as source everywhere); heard-station table with PLI loss from report-counter gaps; heard alerts and own alerts; RxKind on every RF outcome for statistics; feeds RepeatStore and emits re-sent/relayed frames (TxKind) when the queue is empty; saveState/restoreState for store-and-forward persistence

io.responsibility: Boundary interfaces (AudioSink, AudioSource, Ptt, FrameTransport with lastAirtimeMs), the transports (soft modem with optional FX.25 transmit; KissStreamTransport: KISS over any byte stream given a function that opens a KissLink, with reconnect, connected flag and de-duplicated onStatus messages; KissTcpTransport is its TCP subclass; P25DataTransport: one AX.25 frame per UDP datagram over PPP or SLIP to a P25 radio's packet data port; connect returns a P25Line (KissLink + description + readBufferSize + openIp factory; P25Line.serial for PPP/SLIP, P25Line.usbNetwork for RNDIS/ECM) so each connect can detect first; onLinkUp reports negotiated addresses; reconnect, ping replies and air-time pacing; config P25DataConfig (destinations, port, DEFAULT_PORT 50125; P25DataConfig.dmr() = DMR pacing 1.2 kbit/s + 500 ms); P25Line.usbNetwork(multicastDelivery) for DMR; the same transport carries the DMR_DATA backend; SerialDataTransport: owns a KissStreamTransport (onRaw hook + sendRaw) for byte-pipe radios; each frame = AX.25 frame + FCS as KISS (SerialEncoding.BINARY) or a `TW1:`+Base64+CRLF line (TEXT), both always decoded; bad FCS dropped (badFrames); onDiagnostic for damaged frames, foreign text lines and rate-limited raw bytes; paced by throughput/key-up (defaults SerialDataProfile DSTAR_SLOW 900 bps / DSTAR_FAST 2800 / NXDN 1800). P25DataTransport.onIgnored reports non-TAKwave datagrams (P25DataTransport.hex); P25DataConfig.P25_THROUGHPUT_BPS/P25_KEY_UP_MS), the parser for operator-typed PTT command strings, BleKiss (Bluetooth LE KISS service/characteristic/CCCD UUIDs, MTU payloadSize, split into write-sized pieces) and ByteQueueInputStream (blocking InputStream fed with chunks from callbacks: offer/end/fail/close, bounded, counts dropped)

ip.responsibility: User-space IP for a serial link to a radio: Ipv4 (address parse/format/list, RFC 1071 checksum, build/parse UDP, ICMP echo reply; no fragment reassembly), Slip/SlipDecoder (RFC 1055), PppLink (minimal PPP client: RFC 1662 async framing with FCS-16 = ax25.Crc16, all control chars escaped, LCP without auth, IPCP addresses, 45 s negotiation timeout), IpPacketLink interface + SlipLink, IpFraming enum, P25Probe (finds baud and framing: per rate writes LCP Configure-Request + TTL-1 ICMP echo to candidate radio addresses, accepts only FCS/IP-checksum-valid replies, ignores echoed own bytes; P25ProbeResult framing/baud/radioAddress). USB network link (APX portables): Ethernet + Arp (Ethernet.kt), Dhcp client messages (Dhcp.kt), Rndis (control messages over an RndisControl, initialize -> RndisDevice mac/maxTransfer, keep-alive answer, HALT, PACKET_MSG wrap/unwrap), EthernetIpLink (IpPacketLink: DHCP with TTL 1 then configured fallback, ARP for the radio, answers ARP for itself, one feed() = one USB transfer; UsbNetFraming RNDIS|ECM; MulticastDelivery BROADCAST|MULTICAST_MAC|RADIO decides where multicast (DMR talkgroups) goes on the link; Ethernet.multicastMac). DmrVendor (MOTOTRBO 12/225, HYTERA 10/225 unverified; seeds the settings). DmrIp: MOTOTRBO ID-to-IPv4 mapping (radio = CAI network 12.id, talkgroup = CAI group network 225.id, MAX_ID 16776415, parseIds, destinations, defaults radio 192.168.10.1 / PC 192.168.10.2)

datapackage.responsibility: Builds the ATAK mission-package zip that configures the server connection

(root).responsibility: Application class, manual wiring (AppContainer also holds StateFile, pendingProfile and detectedRadio: DetectedRadio set by MainActivity.handleUsbAttached when a Motorola radio, USB vendor 0x0CAD, is plugged in, with DetectedRadio.system P25/DMR/UNKNOWN guessed from the USB product name by DetectedRadio.systemOf; ui/P25RadioUi RadioDetectedDialog asks before switching the backend, and asks MOTOTRBO or APX when a USB network radio's name does not say), single activity: shows the setup guide until Settings.onboardingDone, then Status as home with a saveable back stack of Screen entries (Settings, its pages, Calibrate, Log, About) and a SaveableStateHolder keeping scroll state; accepts takwave://profile links (onCreate/onNewIntent) and shows ProfileImportDialog for any pending profile

data.responsibility: Settings model (including Fx25Mode and the radio guide choices radioService/radioBand/channelWidth/terrain, which the gateway never reads; effectiveChannelWidth) and DataStore persistence; imported key files and cipher construction; Settings <-> TeamProfile mapping and change list; store-and-forward state file (AtomicFile in noBackupFilesDir)

engine.responsibility: RadioEngine wires CotServer + Gateway + transport and owns the tx/status threads, feeds ChannelStats, restores and saves store-and-forward state; RadioStatus (alerts, channel health) and PacketLog state holders

service.responsibility: Foreground service (microphone|connectedDevice), notification, wake lock, USB-detach handling

net.responsibility: Local TCP CoT server (default port Settings.DEFAULT_TAK_PORT 8099; 8087 = ATAK's own input, refused and migrated, DECISIONS 103); share-sheet export of the data package, team profile and log

audio.responsibility: AudioRecord/AudioTrack implementations of AudioSource/AudioSink, audio device enumeration, AudioDevices.hasUsbAudio (any USB sound card attached)

ptt.responsibility: Serial RTS/DTR PTT through usb-serial-for-android, USB permission requests; Bluetooth serial (SPP) PTT that writes key/unkey commands to a paired device. BluetoothDevices (in BluetoothPtt.kt): known() lists paired devices plus BLE TNCs picked in the companion chooser (BluetoothDeviceOption name/lowEnergyOnly/paired), resolve() (paired, or chooser-picked with allowFound), connectSerial (secure SPP, then insecure SPP, then for dataLink up to 3 vendor SDP services; PTT uses SPP only; onNote reports a fallback), openLink (data KissLink) used by KISS, SERIAL_DATA and P25 over Bluetooth, typeOf. BleKissLink: KissLink over the Bluetooth LE KISS GATT service (connect, discover, MTU 247, CCCD notify, one GATT op at a time, acknowledged writes split to MTU, notifications into ByteQueueInputStream, disconnect fails the stream). BleCompanion: CompanionDeviceManager chooser filtered on the BLE KISS service (find, addressFrom result, associated addresses) so no scan/location permission is needed. SerialLinks.probe handles p25Link BLUETOOTH (framing only, stored baud). SerialLinks (SerialLink.kt) opens a USB serial port as a KissLink byte stream (blocking read with timeout 0, RTS/DTR held low) for the P25 backend, open(deviceKey, baud, portIndex) also serves the SERIAL_DATA backend, runs core P25Probe on it (probe), BAUD_RATES, MOTOROLA_VENDOR_ID/isMotorolaRadio

usb.responsibility: UsbNetDevices: finds USB network devices by interface class (RNDIS: 02/02/FF, E0/01/03, EF/04/01; ECM: 02/06), lists them (UsbNetOption), opens them (claims control + CDC data interfaces, RNDIS init via UsbRndisControl on EP0, ECM MAC from the iMACAddress string). UsbNetLink is the KissLink: one bulkTransfer per read/write (pad byte instead of ZLP), RNDIS keep-alive poll thread, HALT on close

ui.notes: BluetoothRadioUi.kt: BluetoothRadioHint (shown by BluetoothDevicePicker for a recognised device: advice + 'Use the X as the modem' via Settings.withBluetoothRadio, and a PTT preset button), BleTncFinder ('Find a Bluetooth LE TNC nearby', StartIntentSenderForResult on BleCompanion), LocalAllowBackendSwitch (false inside OnboardingScreen so hints only explain). BluetoothDevicePicker(selected, hint, settings?, update?, onSelect) lists BluetoothDevices.known. Theme.kt holds Section (optional info button) and InfoButton. Scrollbar.kt provides Modifier.verticalScrollbar(ScrollState | LazyListState); every scrolling surface uses it, placed before verticalScroll. SettingsScreen.kt: SettingsScreen is the list of SettingsPage groups (STATION: station, TAK server, PLI, team profile; RADIO: modem backend, audio, PTT, transmit, Calibrate levels button; CHANNEL: FX.25, CSMA, time slots, store and forward; SECURITY: encryption) with summaries; SettingsPageScreen renders one page; SettingsColumn adds the restart card on every settings screen. It also exposes the setting widgets and AudioDeviceSettings / SerialPttSettings / BluetoothPttSettings / BluetoothKissSettings / BluetoothDevicePicker as internal composables reused by OnboardingScreen.kt. SerialPttSettings takes onUseVox: when no serial adapter but a USB sound card is attached (auto-PTT cable such as the BTECH APRS-K1 PRO) it shows a hint and a 'Use VOX instead' button (Settings: pttMethod VOX + TXDELAY >= VOX_MIN_TX_DELAY_MS; setup guide: switches RadioSetup to VOX_CABLE, landing on the Transmit step). RadioEngine adds the same hint to the 'Serial PTT unavailable' warning. HelpText.kt holds every info-dialog text. StatusScreen.kt shows alert cards, the Channel health section and PLI reception per heard station. TeamProfileUi.kt holds TeamProfileSection (Settings), the share dialog with a ZXing-drawn QR code, and ProfileImportDialog. AboutScreen.kt shows the version (from PackageManager; buildConfig is off), developer, and links (repository, issues, Buy Me a Coffee) opened with ACTION_VIEW only on tap; the URLs are constants at the top of the file. Navigation (MainActivity): no tab row. StatusScreen is home; top bar IconButtons open Log (ic_log), Settings (ic_settings) and About (ic_about); other screens show a back arrow (ic_back) and BackHandler pops the stack. CalibrateScreen opens from Settings > Radio & audio and from 'Adjust levels' in the Status Radio card (StatusScreen onCalibrate); it takes Settings to show the deviation target for effectiveChannelWidth. RadioGuideScreen (Screen.RADIO_GUIDE) opens from the 'Radio guide' section at the top of the Radio & audio page (SettingsPageScreen onRadioGuide); it renders core RadioGuide.advise for the stored choices, warns when encryption is on with the amateur service, links to Calibrate, and can set the suggested FX.25 mode. Labels for the core radio enums and Settings.radioGuideSummary live in RadioGuideScreen.kt; info text HelpText.RADIO_GUIDE. Icons are app vector drawables; no icon library (docs/DECISIONS.md 60).

:usbserial.responsibility: usb-serial-for-android v3.9.0, MIT, unmodified. See usbserial/VENDORED.md

:xmlparser.responsibility: kXML 2 jar minus org/xmlpull/** so R8 accepts it alongside the Android platform's XmlPull API

clientToRadio: cot/CotParser.parse (hardened) -> cot/CotMapper.classify (PLI / chat / marker / ping / drop)
sched/LoopGuard check -> PLI: sched/PliScheduler.update; chat & markers: sched/TxQueue.offer
RadioEngine.transmitLoop -> Gateway.pollFrame (scheduler.due -> queue.poll -> codec/PacketCodec.encode [+ PayloadCipher.seal] -> ax25/Ax25Frame.encode)

io/FrameTransport.send: SoftModemTransport (sched/ChannelAccess: CSMA or time slot -> Ptt.key -> modem/AfskModulator -> AudioSink -> Ptt.unkey in finally) or KissStreamTransport (kiss/Kiss.encode -> TCP via KissTcpTransport, or Bluetooth serial to a radio with a built-in TNC)
radioToClient: modem/AfskDemodulator (filters, slicers, PLL) -> ax25/HdlcDeframer (unstuff, FCS check) -> FrameListener
(or KissStreamTransport, TCP or Bluetooth -> kiss/KissDecoder -> FrameListener; or P25DataTransport, see p25Data)
cot/CotBuilder (adds <__takwave rx="1"/>) -> net/CotServer.sendToAll -> every TAK client
dataFlows.clientRelay: CotServer -> RadioEngine.onClientEvent -> CotServer.sendToAll(except sender) for every valid non-ping event
storeAndForward: Own traffic: Gateway.pollFrame sends a queued chat/marker -> RepeatStore.onOwnSent (records stations in range)

RF: Gateway.onRfFrame -> codec extension (DecodeResult.Ok.hops, ageS) -> originMs = now - age -> SeenCache.accept (NEW / REPEAT / OUTDATED marker version; only NEW is delivered) -> CotBuilder uses originMs for event time and chat remarks time, stale from now -> RepeatStore.onRf (cancels pending repeat; relay stations hold messages heard from their author) -> RepeatStore.onStationHeard (schedules repeats for stations not covered; direct chats only for the recipient via uidSource)

Gateway.pollFrame, queue empty -> RepeatStore.nextDue (hold time, repeats per message, min gap, 10-minute budget) -> PacketCodec.encode(message, hops = 1 for relays, ageS = now - originMs) -> TxItem.kind RESEND/RELAY
Settings resendOwn, relay, repeatHoldMin, repeatMax, repeatGapS, repeatBudget -> RadioEngine -> RepeatConfig; Settings > Channel section 'Store and forward'
emergency: TAK client b-a-* event -> cot/CotMapper.emergency -> EmergencyMessage -> Gateway.offer -> sched/EmergencyBeacon.update (and SeenCache)
Gateway.pollFrame: EmergencyBeacon.due (now, then every 30 s while active; cancel 3 times) -> TxQueue (highest priority) -> codec type 4

RF: Gateway.onRfFrame -> SeenCache (a cancel is a newer version; old alerts OUTDATED) -> rfAlerts (heardAlerts) -> CotBuilder.emergency (stale 10 min); author's repeats of an active alert are delivered every time
Relay stations: RepeatStore holds and relays alerts like chat (ranked first); own alerts are never in RepeatStore
RadioEngine.publish -> RadioStatus.ownAlerts / heardAlerts -> StatusScreen alert cards and the service notification
dataFlows.fx25: Settings.fx25 -> ModemConfig.fx25CheckBytes -> AfskModulator.modulate -> ax25/Fx25.encodeFrame (falls back to plain HDLC when too long). Receive: every AfskDemodulator slicer feeds bits to HdlcDeframer and Fx25Receiver -> ReedSolomon.decode -> HdlcDeframer on the corrected data -> deliver (CRC de-dup; fecRecovered counts frames only FX.25 got)
dataFlows.channelHealth: RadioEngine: status thread samples SoftModemTransport.state into stats/ChannelStats (busy/idle, not TX) and adds deltas of fecRecovered and Gateway.queueDropped; onRfFrame counts RfOutcome.kind; transmitLoop records lastAirtimeMs or TX_FAILED -> ChannelStats.snapshot -> RadioStatus.health -> StatusScreen. PLI loss: Gateway encodes a station-wide report counter (extension bit 5) on PLIs; receivers count gaps per source into HeardStation.pliReceived/pliMissed
dataFlows.teamProfile: Share: ui/TeamProfileUi ProfileShareDialog -> data/TeamProfiles Settings.toTeamProfile -> core profile/TeamProfile.toUri -> QR (ZXing) / net/Sharing.shareProfile / clipboard. Load: takwave://profile link (MainActivity intent filter), file (OpenDocument, 2 KB cap) or clipboard -> AppContainer.pendingProfile -> ProfileImportDialog: TeamProfile.parse + Settings.withTeamProfile + profileChanges -> Apply -> SettingsStore.update
dataFlows.hiddenCallsign: Settings.hideCallsign (effective only via Settings.callsignHidden, i.e. while encryption is on; also in TeamProfile 'hide') -> RadioEngine (only with a working cipher) -> Gateway(hideSource) -> PacketCodec.encode(hiddenSource) version 1. RF: Gateway.onRfFrame decodes, takes DecodeResult.Ok.hiddenSource as source, own-echo check after decryption; hidden traffic relayed only by hiding relays. UI: SettingsScreen EncryptionDetails switch + warning card; HelpText.ENCRYPTION; TeamProfileUi import warning. docs/PROTOCOL.md section 6 'Hidden source'
dataFlows.storeForwardPersistence: RadioEngine.startBlocking: data/StateFile.read -> Gateway.restoreState (parse fully, then apply; drops held messages if encryption or callsign hiding was switched; protection byte 0 clear / 1 encrypted / 2 hidden) ; status thread every 30 s and releaseAll on stop: Gateway.saveState -> StateFile.write when changed
dataFlows.settings: ui/SettingsScreen -> data/SettingsStore (DataStore) ; read once by service/TakwaveService when it builds RadioEngine
dataFlows.radioGuide: ui/RadioGuideScreen choices -> SettingsStore (radioService, radioBand, channelWidth, terrain; a terrain change resets the band to RadioGuide.recommendedBand, a service change coerces the width) -> core radio/RadioGuide.advise -> RadioAdvice rendered on screen ; optional 'Use this FX.25 setting' writes Settings.fx25 ; CalibrateScreen reads Settings.effectiveChannelWidth for its deviation text. Nothing reaches the gateway (docs/DECISIONS.md 104-107)
dataFlows.onboarding: MainActivity shows ui/OnboardingScreen while Settings.onboardingDone is false: welcome -> permissions -> quick-start offer -> callsign -> radio setup (USB interface / VOX cable / Bluetooth serial PTT / radio with built-in Bluetooth TNC / KISS TNC / acoustic) -> setup-specific steps (Step.KISS shows BluetoothKissSettings or the TCP host/port depending on the setup) -> done. Values are written straight to SettingsStore; Skip or Finish sets onboardingDone; Settings > 'Run the setup guide again' clears it
dataFlows.bluetoothPtt: Settings (btPttDevice, btPttPreset, btKeyCommand, btUnkeyCommand) -> RadioEngine.buildSoftModem -> core io/PttCommand.parse -> ptt/BluetoothPtt.open (RFCOMM SPP to a paired device, sends unkey first) -> used as Ptt by SoftModemTransport ; link loss -> RadioEngine.onBluetoothPttLost (pttLost, audio abort, warning)
dataFlows.bluetoothKiss: Settings (backend KISS_BLUETOOTH, kissBtDevice = MAC of a paired or chooser-picked device, kissBtLink BluetoothKissLink AUTO|CLASSIC|BLE) -> RadioEngine.buildBluetoothKiss -> core io/KissStreamTransport with a connect function: CLASSIC ptt/BluetoothDevices.openLink (RFCOMM SPP with fallbacks), BLE ptt/BleKissLink.open (GATT, core io/BleKiss), AUTO openBluetoothKissAuto (BLE for LE-only/unpaired, else classic then BLE; remembers what worked) -> KISS frames both ways; the radio's TNC (e.g. BTECH UV-PRO) does modulation, channel access and PTT. Link down -> send refused, retry every 5 s, RadioStatus.backendInfo gets '(not connected)', status messages go to the log. No device chosen -> backend does not start. UI: SettingsScreen BluetoothDevicePicker (shared with Bluetooth PTT) + BluetoothKissSettings (link choice, ui/BluetoothRadioUi BleTncFinder); HelpText.KISS_BLUETOOTH; StatusScreen asks for BLUETOOTH_CONNECT on Start. docs/DECISIONS.md 108-112, 149-153; untested on real hardware (docs/TODO.md)
dataFlows.bluetoothRadioHints: ui/SettingsScreen BluetoothDevicePicker -> selected BluetoothDeviceOption.name -> core radio/BluetoothRadios.match -> ui/BluetoothRadioUi BluetoothRadioHint (advice text; button applies Settings.withBluetoothRadio: KISS_BLUETOOTH or SERIAL_DATA over Bluetooth; PTT preset KENWOOD_HT / ICOM_IC705 button in the Bluetooth PTT context). Hidden switch buttons in the setup guide (LocalAllowBackendSwitch). DECISIONS 153-154
dataFlows.p25Data: Settings (backend P25_DATA, p25Link SerialLinkKind USB|BLUETOOTH, p25BtDevice (Bluetooth serial adapter on the data cable: connect skips USB, probes framing only via SerialLinks.probe, waits BT_REOPEN_DELAY_MS, then BluetoothDevices.openLink -> P25Line.serial; DECISIONS 151), p25Device, p25Baud, p25Framing PPP|SLIP, p25LocalIp, p25RadioIp, p25Destinations, p25Port, p25AutoDetect default true; Settings.p25Problem validates; withP25Detected) -> RadioEngine.buildP25Data -> core io/P25DataTransport with connect = [if usb/UsbNetDevices.find (chosen device, or with Automatic any attached USB network radio): UsbNetDevices.open -> P25Line.usbNetwork (DHCP when auto) ; else serial: if auto: ptt/SerialLinks.probe -> core ip/P25Probe, result saved via RadioEngine.saveSettings (service writes SettingsStore)] + SerialLinks.open -> P25Line; onLinkUp saves negotiated addresses when auto -> core ip/IpPacketLink (PppLink or SlipLink) -> each frame: ip/Ipv4.buildUdp to every destination (default 255.255.255.255) -> serial -> radio's P25 modem. RX: serial -> IpPacketLink -> Ipv4.parsePacket/parseUdp (configured port only; ICMP echo answered) -> FrameListener -> Gateway.onRfFrame. send() sleeps the air-time estimate. Link down -> refused, retry every 5 s, '(not connected)'. UI: SettingsScreen P25DataSettings (auto-detect switch, ui/P25RadioUi P25DetectButton; shared with OnboardingScreen Step.P25, RadioSetup.P25_RADIO), HelpText.P25_DATA. USB attach of a Motorola radio -> MainActivity (DetectedRadio.Link USB_NETWORK / SERIAL / NONE) -> AppContainer.detectedRadio -> RadioDetectedDialog -> backend P25_DATA + p25Device + auto-detect (restarts a running gateway). docs/PROTOCOL.md section 10, docs/DECISIONS.md 113-129; untested on real hardware (docs/TODO.md)
dataFlows.radioTuning: Settings radioDataBps (0 = default), radioKeyUpMs (-1 = default), radioDataLog; Settings.radioPacingDefaults / radioPacing per backend (P25, DMR, SERIAL_DATA) -> RadioEngine buildP25Data/buildDmrData/buildSerialData pacing + logPacing; radioDataLogger() -> P25DataTransport.onIgnored / SerialDataTransport.onDiagnostic -> log. RadioEngine.checkDamagedFrames warns once after BAD_FRAME_WARNING (5) damaged serial frames. UI: ui/RadioTuningUi RadioTuningSettings ('Tuning and troubleshooting' section on the RADIO page for those backends), HelpText.RADIO_TUNING. DECISIONS 144-148
dataFlows.serialData: Settings (backend SERIAL_DATA, serialEncoding BINARY|TEXT, serialRadioType SerialRadioType DSTAR_SLOW|DSTAR_FAST|KENWOOD_NXDN|ICOM_IDAS -> core SerialDataProfile, serialRadioLink SerialLinkKind USB|BLUETOOTH, serialRadioUsbDevice, serialRadioUsbPort, serialRadioBaud, serialRadioBtDevice; serialRadioProblem, serialRadioSummary) -> RadioEngine.buildSerialData -> core io/KissStreamTransport (connect = ptt/SerialLinks.open(device, baud, port) or ptt/BluetoothDevices.connectSerial) wrapped in core io/SerialDataTransport (FCS inside KISS, pacing) -> radio's data port, radio keys itself. RX: KissDecoder -> FCS check -> Gateway.onRfFrame. UI: ui/SerialRadioUi SerialDataSettings (Settings RADIO page, OnboardingScreen Step.SERIAL_DATA for RadioSetup.DSTAR_RADIO / NXDN_RADIO), HelpText.SERIAL_DATA; StatusScreen asks BLUETOOTH_CONNECT when the link is Bluetooth. docs/PROTOCOL.md 10.2, DECISIONS 140-143; untested on real hardware
dataFlows.dmrData: Settings (backend DMR_DATA, dmrGroupDelivery MulticastDelivery default RADIO, dmrCustomDestinations (IP list replacing computed destinations), dmrVendor DmrVendor MOTOTRBO|HYTERA (Settings.withDmrVendor resets the CAI networks; DmrVendor.label in data/Settings.kt), dmrDevice, dmrLocalIp, dmrRadioIp, dmrAutoAddresses default true, dmrTalkgroup default 1, dmrRadioIds, dmrCaiNetwork 12, dmrCaiGroupNetwork 225, dmrPort; Settings.dmrDestinations / dmrProblem / dmrTargetsText via core ip/DmrIp) -> RadioEngine.buildDmrData -> core io/P25DataTransport with P25DataConfig.dmr pacing; connect = usb/UsbNetDevices.find(dmrDevice) (error when none) -> UsbNetDevices.open -> P25Line.usbNetwork(multicastDelivery = dmrGroupDelivery, DHCP when auto) -> core ip/EthernetIpLink; onLinkUp saves DHCP addresses when auto. Each frame: UDP to 225.x.y.z (talkgroup) and 12.x.y.z per radio ID, all to the radio's MAC. RX: same as p25Data. UI: ui/DmrRadioUi DmrDataSettings (Settings RADIO page and OnboardingScreen Step.DMR, RadioSetup.DMR_RADIO), HelpText.DMR_DATA (CPS checklist: Forward to PC, CAI networks, compressed UDP header). USB attach -> RadioDetectedDialog (DMR or ask). docs/PROTOCOL.md section 10.1, docs/DECISIONS.md 130-137; untested on real hardware (docs/TODO.md)
dataFlows.keys: ui/SettingsScreen file picker -> data/KeyFiles.import (validates via core codec/KeyLoader) -> files/keys/* ; KeyFiles.buildCipher at gateway start
dataFlows.status: RadioEngine.publish (10 Hz) -> AppContainer.status StateFlow -> Compose screens and the service notification
dataFlows.dataPackage: ui/StatusScreen -> net/Sharing.shareDataPackage -> core datapackage/DataPackage.build -> FileProvider -> share sheet -> ATAK

build.thirdParty: com.google.zxing:core (Apache-2.0) in :app for QR generation only
build.release: scripts/build-release.sh <vX.Y.Z>: clones the pushed tag, applies the F-Droid recipe's rm/prebuild steps, ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleRelease, apksigner (alignment-preserved, v2+v3) -> dist/<tag>/TAKwave-X.Y.Z.apk, checks cert vs recipe AllowedAPKSigningKeys, fdroidserver verify_apks. Secrets: ~/.config/takwave-release/release.env. Full procedure and current F-Droid state: AGENTS.md 'Release workflow'
